about: Water names in DE's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for DE, one row per name and county with the number of records, how many are open now, up to five points ([lat, lon], 0.001 degree), towns and sources, for the names pass. Records naming no water and releases DNREC's form marks to ground only are left out (by_reason). Written by scripts/de_sc_report_water_names.py.
